notes: Block for well 7/35-26J4: 12 dated water levels (4 rows x 3 column pairs), one per month but printed as dates, so discrete. The table prints month and day only; year 1953 taken from the well heading on this page (highest water level 7.50 below lsd, Jan. 27, 1953, equals the table's Jan. 27 value; records available 1947-53). If that is not allowed, the dates are blank. County blank: 'County of Santa Barbara' is only the owner's name. Also printed: Artesia Avenue and Central Avenue. No state, basin or drilling date on the page. Faint scan: well number letter read as J.
